label.text: Hi ${firstName}, an authenticator app is now paired with your Darpan account, set up ${at}.
Its six-digit codes sign you in from here on. They change every 30 seconds, so don't bother memorising them, and try not to get attached.
Not you? Change your password and tell your Darpan administrator, who can reset your two-factor.
